caption:
No one warns you about this… 

#life #wellnessjourney #healing #usa
transcript: Do you know what no one warns you about? The day siblings stop sharing daily life. One day you're fighting over snacks, laughing at nothing. Then suddenly you're strangers in different worlds. Childhood feels endless until adulthood scatters everyone into cities, routines and priorities that rarely align. The people who once knew you best slowly become the ones you barely check off. It won't be the fights you remember. It'll be late night talks, secrets, the shared laughter. Those ordinary days you thought would last forever were the rarest gifts you'll ever hold. While you still can, reach out. Siblings aren't just blood, they're pieces of your first home. So tell me, when was the last time you laughed with your siblings the way you used to? Follow for reminders that actually matter and comment, I miss them if this brought someone to mind.
